name: Zerk
body:
Price 50 gp

DETAILS

Type: drug (injury); Addiction: minor, Fortitude DC 18

EFFECTS

1 hour; +1 alchemical bonus to initiative. If addicted, the user also gains a +1d4 alchemical bonus to Strength for as long as he is addicted.

DAMAGE

1d2 Con damage
